Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On February 2, 1913: New York City's Grand Central Terminal, the world's largest train station by number of platforms, opened immediately after midnight.
On February 2, 1959: Nine experienced ski hikers in the northern Ural Mountains in the Soviet Union die under mysterious circumstances.

On February 2, 2025: Slovenian NBA player Luka Doncic is traded from the Dallas Mavericks to the Los Angeles Lakers in exchange for Anthony Davis in one of the largest trades in American sports history.
On February 2, 2000: First digital cinema projection in Europe (Paris) realized by Philippe Binant with the DLP CINEMA technology developed by Texas Instruments.
On February 2, 1887: In Punxsutawney, Pennsylvania, the first Groundhog Day is observed.
